sec.title: August 27 Archival Enrichment (Increment 213)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American network radio, Mark Warnow conducting all-time popular standards on *Your All-Time Hit Parade* for Lucky Strike (1943 Gershwin, 1944 Irving Berlin), two Hollywood adaptations on *Lux Radio Theatre* for Lux Toilet Soap (Claudette Colbert & Fred MacMurray in *Practically Yours*, Irene Dunne as Queen Victoria in *The Mudlark*), H.V. Kaltenborn's war eve analysis, and CBS live battlefield dispatches from liberated Paris (1939–1951):
